newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield at Indian 364 day t-bill rises to 10.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield at Indian 364 day t-bill rises to 10.43 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off price of 90.58 rupees at its fortnightly auction of 364-day treasury bills on Wednesday.
The cut-off price at the last auction was 90.83 rupees.
Dealers said the yield worked out to 10.43 percent, up from 10.12 percent at the last auction.
The RBI said it received 15 bids for a total of 1.97 billion rupees and accepted six of these for 550 million rupees.
